dialogues.text: You shouldn't be playing this, this is not a game.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who's that?
I'm Game, the game you're playing right now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You said that you're a game yourself, so why can't I play you?
In short,you can't play.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I don't believe it.

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: What are you doing!

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: Lock my door back!

dialogues.speaker: System
dialogues.text: ENDING 1: Expelled from the Game. You were swallowed by the void.
Oh my, looks like Game, you and this user are getting along quite well.

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: Mr. Glitch!!!

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Glitch
dialogues.text: You're no longer a complete game anymore.

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Glitch
dialogues.text: Even in this state, you still have your own player. That's truly surprising.

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: Shut up! Who do you think made me incomplete in the first place!

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: My lost code!

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: Player, help me. I became incomplete precisely because that stolen code was taken from me.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Alright... fine. What do I need to do?

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Glitch
dialogues.text: Come, face me in a duel. Defeat me, and I'll return the code to you.

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: Thank you, user. I'm sorry for being so harsh to you before. Thank you for helping me.

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: Even so, I won't let you play.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why?

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: Even if I were a complete game, I could never exist as a proper, good game.

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: Noooo! Don't press that button!

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh... and this is exactly why I refused to let you play me...

dialogues.speaker: Game
dialogues.text: I'm a terrible, awful game...

dialogues.speaker: Mr. Glitch
dialogues.text: Hahaha! Your presence has been successfully deleted from this server.

dialogues.speaker: System
dialogues.text: ENDING 2: System Deletion. You are no longer part of the code.
